rule: order = the order of the code slides of the deck; the page tab lists the examples by name in this order; each runs as setup + listing, with the library defined in the page

setup.code:
# setup: the chapter library of the page (L = the chapter 9 library, with the recorded runs of Bitcoin Core 31.1 and the census of two blocks, R, R2 and C); the page boots these names
import sen0401_ch09_lib_v1_0_1 as L
R, R2, C = L.run(), L.run2(), L.census()
B = C['blocks']

examples.name: A fee is a difference, not a field
examples.code:
a = R['fee_arith']
t = L.parse_tx(a['tx']['hex'])
has_fee = 'fee' in t
n_in, n_out = len(t['vin']), len(t['vout'])
outs = sum(o['value'] for o in t['vout'])
ins = round(a['inputs_btc'] * 1e8)
fee = ins - outs
(has_fee, fee)

examples.name: A forgotten change output pays the miner
examples.code:
a = R['fee_arith']
why = a['testmempoolaccept']['reject-reason']
err = a['sendrawtransaction_default']['error']
guard = 'maxfeerate' in err
bs = a['blockstats']
pay = bs['subsidy'] + bs['totalfee']
paid = a['coinbase_out_sat'] == pay
(why, guard, paid)

examples.name: A signed payment cannot be edited
examples.code:
w = R2['tamper']
o, t = w['original'], w['tampered']
ok = [o['allowed'], t['allowed']]
why = t['reject-reason'].split(' (')[0]
d = w['output0_original_sat']
cut = d - w['output0_tampered_sat']
(ok, cut)

examples.name: Size, weight and virtual size
examples.code:
x = R['rbf']['t1']
t = L.parse_tx(x['hex'])
sizes = [t['base_size'], t['size']]
wv = [t['weight'], t['vsize']]
ratio = round(x['vsize'] / x['weight'], 4)
sizes + wv

examples.name: A fee rate and its units
examples.code:
x = R['rbf']['t1']
rate = x['fee_sat'] / x['vsize']
a = float(L.btc_kvb_to_sat_vb('0.00006570'))
b = float(L.btc_kvb_to_sat_vb('0.00001225'))
p = R['units']['fee_rate_sat_vb_10']['ok']['fee']
q = R['units']['feeRate_btc_kvb_0.0001']['ok']['fee']
same = p == q
(rate, a, b, same)

examples.name: Space in a block is limited
examples.code:
src = 'core_src_consensus_consensus.h'
limit = int(L.const(src, 'MAX_BLOCK_WEIGHT'))
w = B['840000']['weight']
share = round(100 * w / limit, 2)
(w, limit, share)

examples.name: The minimum relay fee
examples.code:
m = list(R['minrelay'].values())[:3]
fees = [v['fee_sat'] for v in m]
taken = [v['result']['ok'][0]['allowed'] for v in m]
floor = R2['mempool_min']['minrelaytxfee'] * 1e8 / 1000
need = int(141 * floor) + 1
(fees, taken, need)

examples.name: Dust and the wallet's own floor
An estimate needs history
examples.code:
f = R['estimate_fresh']['ok']['errors'][0]
n = R['estimate']['rounds']
E = R['estimate']['results']
fr = lambda t: E[f'{t}_default']['ok']['feerate']
rates = [round(fr(t) * 1e5, 3) for t in (2, 6, 25)]
rates

examples.name: How far the estimator can see
examples.code:
E = R['estimate']['results']
seen = E['144_default']['ok']['blocks']
ts = (2, 6, 25, 144)
eco = [E[f'{t}_economical'] for t in ts]
dft = [E[f'{t}_default'] for t in ts]
same = eco == dft
cons = E['144_default'] == E['144_conservative']
(seen, same, cons)

examples.name: Two blocks, two fee markets
examples.code:
a = L.census_stats(840000)
b = L.census_stats(971489)
n = a['n']
med = [a['median_rate'], b['median_rate']]
med

examples.name: The opt-in replacement signal
examples.code:
sig = L.rbf_signal
flags = [sig([0xfffffffd]), sig([0xfffffffe])]
mixed = sig([0xffffffff, 0xfffffffd])
a = L.census_stats(840000)
b = L.census_stats(971489)
share = [a['signal_rbf'], b['signal_rbf']]
(flags, mixed, share)

examples.name: A replacement must pay enough
examples.code:
X = R['rbf']
ks = ['lower_fee', 'equal_fee']
ks += ['short_by_one', 'exactly_enough']
fees = [X[k]['fee_sat'] for k in ks]
taken = ['ok' in X[k]['result'] for k in ks]
need = L.min_replacement_fee(564, 141)
(fees, taken)

examples.name: Full replacement is the default
examples.code:
x = R['rbf']
seq = x['t1']['sequence']
full = x['fullrbf_flag']
swapped = 'ok' in x['t2']['result']
o = R2['removed_option']
m = o['message']
gone = (o['exit_code'], 'mempoolfullrbf=0' in m)
(full, seq, swapped, gone)

examples.name: Paying the payee twice
examples.code:
h = R2['hazard']
i = h['inputs']
c01 = L.conflict(i['v0'], i['v1'])
c12 = L.conflict(i['v1'], i['v2'])
c02 = L.conflict(i['v0'], i['v2'])
asked = h['payee_asked_sat']
got = h['payee_received_sat']
(asked, got, [c01, c12, c02])

examples.name: A child lifts its parent
examples.code:
w = R['ancestor_mining']['cpfp_wins']
E = w['mempoolentries']
fee = w['fees_sat']
rate = lambda k: fee[k] / E[k]['vsize']
alone = [rate('P'), rate('C')]
c = E['P']
fee_c = c['fees']['chunk'] * 1e8
pair = round(fee_c / (c['chunkweight'] / 4), 2)
(alone, pair)

examples.name: A weak child does not help
examples.code:
w = R['ancestor_mining']['cpfp_loses']
E, fee = w['mempoolentries'], w['fees_sat']
c = E['P']
tot = fee['P'] + fee['C']
pair = round(tot / (c['chunkweight'] / 4), 2)
mined = lambda k: w[k]['txid'] in w['block_txids']
first = [mined('A'), mined('P')]
(pair, first)

examples.name: Package relay
examples.code:
p = R['package']
solo = p['v2_parent_alone']['ok'][0]['reject-details']
alone = L.reason(p['child_alone'])

msg

examples.name: Cluster limits
examples.code:
c = R['cluster']
mi = c['mempoolinfo']
lim = (mi['limitclustercount'], mi['limitclustersize'])
ch = c['chain']
tried = (ch['attempted'], ch['accepted'])
why = L.reason(ch['first_refusal'])
ok26 = ch['accepted_26th']
(lim, tried, why, ok26)

examples.name: Mempool size and expiry
examples.code:
o = 'core_src_kernel_mempool_options.h'
size = int(L.const(o, 'DEFAULT_MAX_MEMPOOL_SIZE_MB'))
hours = int(L.const(o, 'DEFAULT_MEMPOOL_EXPIRY_HOURS'))
days = hours // 24
(size, hours, days)

examples.name: A big child pins its parent
examples.code:
P = R['pinning']
v2, v3 = P['v2'], P['v3']
cost2 = v2['replacement_enough']['fee_sat']
cost3 = v3['replacement_enough']['fee_sat']
ratio = round(cost2 / cost3)
(cost2, cost3, ratio)

examples.name: TRUC limits on a family
examples.code:
t = R['truc']
why = L.reason
bad = 'TRUC-violation' in why(t['big_child']['result'])
ok = 'ok' in t['child1']['result']
r1 = why(t['sibling_same_rate']['result'])
r2 = t['sibling_higher_rate']['result']
ev = ['sibling eviction' in r1, 'ok' in r2]
(bad, ok, ev)

examples.name: Pay to anchor
examples.code:
p = R['package']
par = L.parse_tx(p['truc_parent']['hex'])
o = par['vout'][0]

empty = [v['witness'] for v in kid['vin']].count([])
anchor

examples.name: The carve-out limit
examples.code:
p = 'core_src_policy_policy.h'
lim = int(L.const(p, 'EXTRA_DESCENDANT_TX_SIZE_LIMIT'))
bk = 'book_ch09_fees.adoc'
said = 'additional transaction up to 1,000 vbytes'
book = L.has(bk, said)
n = 'core_relnotes_31.0.html'
gone = L.has(n, 'removed from the mempool logic')

examples.name: Fees against the subsidy
examples.code:
a, b = B['840000']['extras'], B['971489']['extras']
fees, reward = a['totalFees'], a['reward']
subsidy = reward - fees
f = lambda z: z['totalFees'] / z['reward']
share = [round(100 * f(z), 2) for z in (a, b)]
share

examples.name: Odds of winning a sniping race
examples.code:
xs = [0.1, 0.3, 0.45, 0.5]
odds = [L.snipe_probability(x) for x in xs]
pct = [round(100 * p, 2) for p in odds]
pct

examples.name: Wallets lock to the chain tip
examples.code:
s = R['sniping']['samples']
gap = sorted(z['tip'] - z['locktime'] for z in s)
at_tip = gap.count(0)
back = [g for g in gap if g]
late = L.is_final(100001, 100001, [0xfffffffd])
(at_tip, back, late)
